issue.title: Greenfield Scaffold Phase C: autonomous worker execution proof
acceptanceCriteria: Use the Phase B candidate-only queue-readiness contract without mutating source queueReadiness artifacts.
Materialize exactly one bounded proof job derived from a Phase B candidate.
Run through the worker_job execution boundary with explicit allowed paths and validation commands.
Stop at review/proof without creating a PR or autolanding from inside the worker run.
nonGoals: No autoland or PR creation from the worker execution proof.

proofJobs.goal: Prove one bounded Phase C worker_job execution path from a Phase B Greenfield candidate.
proofJobs.implementationCommand:
node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('docs/initiatives/greenfield-scaffold/phase-c-worker-proof.md','# Phase C Worker Proof

- status: review_ready_boundary
- sourceCandidateId: issue-002
')"

prBoundary.reason: Phase C proof stops at review/proof and does not create or merge a PR from the worker run.

tddSlice.firstTracerBehavior: A Phase B candidate reference produces one bounded worker_job proof and stops before PR/autoland.
tddSlice.publicInterface: npm run harness:worker-execute -- run --initiative greenfield-scaffold --job-id phase-c-greenfield-worker-proof-issue-002 --max-steps <n> --max-runtime-seconds <n>
tddSlice.mockPlan: Use a local node command that writes one proof markdown file under the Greenfield docs allowed path.
